The page says the annual cycle is "Reference due April 7" and that applications close at 11:59 PM MDT; the scholarships overview page gives the same March 31 deadline. The sponsor's other tracks (Graduate, Vocational, Summer, Fellowships) have different windows and amounts and were not used. The official_url quote is the page's title line; the listing's cobellscholar.org/ homepage has no deadline or amount, so the track page was used instead.
